app.title: My Diary
app.loadFailedBody: Nothing has been changed or deleted. Try again, or restart the app.
app.saveFailedBody: Your last change may be lost when the app closes. Try again, and save a backup from Settings.

memories.hint: Keep writing. In a week, today’s entry will come back to you here.
memories.lettersReady_one: A letter from your past self

entries.emptyBody: Tap the + button to write your first entry.
entries.noEntriesThisDay: No entries this day. Tap + to write one.

editor.discardBody: Your edits to this entry will be lost.
editor.nothingBody: Write something or add a photo first.

placeNote.unavailable: Current location isn’t available here. You can type the place instead.
placeNote.denied: Location access is off. You can type the place instead.
placeNote.servicesOff: Location services are turned off. You can type the place instead.
placeNote.notFound: Couldn’t find a place name. You can type it instead.

composer.title: Letter to future you
composer.placeholder: What’s on your mind today? What do you hope has changed, or stayed the same?
composer.emptyBody: Write a few words to your future self first.
composer.sealBody: You won’t be able to read or change it until {{when}}.
composer.tooSoon: Choose a time at least 10 minutes from now.
composer.tooFar: Choose a time within 3 years from now.

letters.title: Letters
letters.intro: Write to the person you’ll be. The letter stays sealed until the moment you choose.
letters.write: Write a letter to future you
letters.notificationsOff: Turn on notifications to be told when a letter opens.
letters.tip: Long-press a letter to delete it.
letters.deleteSealed: It will be gone before you ever get to read it.

lock.title: Your diary is locked
lock.confirmOn: Confirm to turn on the lock
lock.confirmOff: Confirm to turn off the lock

settings.title: Settings
settings.lockSub: Ask for Face ID, fingerprint or your passcode when the app opens.
settings.setupLockTitle: Set up a screen lock first
settings.setupLockBody: To lock your diary, your phone needs a passcode, fingerprint or face unlock. You can set one up in your phone’s settings.
settings.backupNote: Your diary lives only on this phone. Save a backup now and then, so you don’t lose it if you change or lose your phone.
settings.saveBackupSub: Entries, photos and letters in one file. Save it to Files, Google Drive or email.
settings.restoreSub: Adds entries and letters from a backup file. Nothing you have now is deleted.
settings.backupWarning: The backup file isn’t encrypted, and it includes your sealed letters. Keep it somewhere private.
settings.footer: No account. No ads. Your words never leave this phone unless you save a backup.
settings.licensesSub: The fonts used in this app and their licenses.

licenses.title: Open-source licenses
licenses.intro: This app uses these fonts under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.

backup.nothingNew: Everything in that backup is already in your diary.
backup.skipped_one: {{count}} item was damaged and left out.
backup.skipped_other: {{count}} items were damaged and left out.
backup.noSharing: Sharing is not available on this device.
backup.notABackup: That file isn’t a diary backup.
backup.tooNew: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Please update the app first.

notifications.title: A letter from your past self ✉️
notifications.body: You wrote it on {{date}}. It’s open now.
